name: Málaga · Costa del Sol
tagline: Picasso's city, a Moorish fortress and the beach
summary: The gateway to the Costa del Sol has become a city of museums, with a Moorish fortress above the port and a city beach. It is the best base for Ronda, the Caminito del Rey and the white villages.
seasonNote: Over 300 days of sun; winters are mild enough for lunch outdoors. Holy Week processions in spring are among Spain's biggest.
arrival: The airport is 8 km away; the C1 train reaches the centre in 12 minutes. High-speed trains from Madrid take 2 hours 40 minutes.
gettingAround: The centre is walkable; buses and the coast train serve the beaches. Ronda and the Caminito need a bus, train or car.
foodTip: Espetos (sardines grilled on skewers over a beach fire), pescaíto frito, ajoblanco cold soup and sweet Málaga wine.
buyTip: Sweet Málaga wine, olive oil and ceramics.
baseArea: The historic centre near Calle Larios

connections.note: Trains via Córdoba or buses in 2 hours 45 minutes.

items.name: Alcazaba and Gibralfaro

items.tip: Take the bus up to Gibralfaro and walk down through the Alcazaba; free on Sunday afternoons.
